full_judgment: 35. In the event of conflict between the old record of right and the recent record of right, the recent record of right would prevail in as much as presumption of the record of right loses its weight with the passage of time and entries in the subsequent khatian would be mere acceptable to a court than the entries in the earlier khatian. In the case of assessment of relative value of two khatians, the latest khatian should prevail over the earlier khatian. Support of this proposition of law is sought to be drawn from in the case of Abdul Hamid vs Abul Hossain Mir being dead his heirs, Abdus Sobhan Mir reported in 35 DLR 295.
